questions.stem: What is the primary advantage of using intermediate representation in compilers?

options.text: It allows for easier analysis and optimization.
It directly translates source code to machine code.
It increases the complexity of the compiler.
It makes the source code harder to understand.

questions.explanation: Intermediate representation provides a platform-independent way to perform optimizations and analyses, which are difficult to achieve directly on source or machine code. This is one of its primary advantages.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of three-address code?

options.text: Each instruction can have at most three operands.
It represents code in a tree structure.
Variables can be assigned multiple times.
It is only used for syntax analysis.

questions.explanation: Three-address code is characterized by instructions that can have at most three operands, making it a linearized representation of the code. This simplifies translation to machine code.
